build_local_vit_model: build a LocalViT model for image classification with configurable patch size and transformer depth
create_transformer_blocks: create a Transformer module with residual attention and feed-forward layers excluding the CLS token
create_attention_layer: create a multi-head self-attention layer with query-key-value projections and softmax weighting
create_feedforward_layer: create a feed-forward layer using depthwise convolutions and hardswish activations on patch tokens
test_local_vit_forward: test the LocalViT forward pass by passing an image tensor and returning classification logits
